purpose: After accepted real-SWAP C2a and after applying the C2b rain forcing, probe each real-SWAP participant independently from its exact committed C2a origin at the C2b interface head and exact absolute time window. Determine whether a unique column response is visible or all 50 columns exhibit the same backend transaction outcome.

probe_contract.state_origin: The 50 real-SWAP participants after the native C2a transaction has published once; revision and interface ledger count equal one.
probe_contract.forcing: The C2E-AB01 fixed infiltration setting: top_flux = -0.1 cm/day.
probe_contract.execution: One discarded backend run_trial per participant; no application-service coupling iteration and no MODFLOW state publication are claimed by this probe.
probe_contract.immutability_gate: The full committed profile hash, all participant revisions, storage observations and all interface ledger counts must match exactly before and after the 50 probes.

interpretation_rules.one_or_more_distinct_outcomes: Report the participant slots and diagnostic-code vectors; do not claim that the full application service necessarily fails first at the same slot.
interpretation_rules.all_outcomes_identical: Report no participant-specific difference in this independent probe; this does not identify the service's first-failing participant.
interpretation_rules.all_probes_pass_but_c2b_rejects: Keep the cause unresolved between multi-participant/application assembly and aspects not reproduced by an isolated participant trial.

gates.fresh_process_replay: Repeat the full real-SWAP C2a/C2b run and all 50 probes in an independent process; require exact JSON identity.

authorization.authorized_by: user instruction in active Work session
authorization.scope: Local test-only participant probes and persisted bounded research evidence.
